name: unsupported-widget-placeholder
description: UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder with every optional prop populated. Pins the wire-format shape of the Epic 38 placeholder primitive used by the Flutter Web preview editor and the dashboard missing-widgets screen. The preview renderer substitutes this node in place of plugin widgets whose manifest declares isSupportedOnWeb: false and that did not register a web stub. Semantically distinct from FallbackPrompt — this case is 'known widget, unsupported platform', not 'unknown widget, forward-compat miss'.
